fatal_flaw: The script defines 'entered' as decisions.jsonl action in {ENTER_BULL, ENTER_BEAR, PLACED} without ever cross-checking automation/state/fills-ledger.jsonl. The decision layer logs the identical persisting signal on every ~1-minute tick while a setup condition holds, regardless of whether a trade already filled or a downstream constraint blocked execution -- so a single real trade (or zero trades) can generate many raw 'entries'. This inflation is base-rate present everywhere (1.2x-1.6x window-wide) but is 3-5x worse specifically in the mirror-direction (Table B) subset the report's headline claim rests on, which reverses the reported asymmetry once corrected.
